hr.leave: Annual leave accrues at 1.75 days a month, capped at 30 days. Sick leave is 10 days a year. Requests go to the line manager and are pending until approved. Unpaid leave needs the HR lead.
hr.remote: Anyone may work remotely up to three days a week. Full remote needs a written agreement with the manager, reviewed every six months.
hr.onboarding: New starters get a laptop, accounts and a buddy on day one, a 30-day check-in with the manager and a 90-day review.
hr.conduct: Treat people with respect. Concerns go to the manager or the HR lead; anonymous reports go through the ethics mailbox. Retaliation is a dismissal matter.
hr.expenses: Expense claims are a finance matter. Ask the finance assistant.

rules.travel: Book through the travel tool where possible. Economy flights, standard hotel rooms. Receipts required above 25.
rules.meals: Per person, per day, while travelling or hosting a customer. No alcohol.
rules.equipment: Peripherals and accessories only. Laptops and phones are ordered by IT, not expensed.
rules.software: Monthly subscriptions need a note of what it replaces. Annual plans go through procurement.
rules.training: Courses and conferences related to the current role. Approved by the manager beforehand.
rules.default: Receipts required above 25. Submit within 30 days. Claims over the category limit need the finance lead.
